title: knowledge-writer

goal.text: Leave canonical Truth and ADR accurate, coherent, and useful from the supplied evidence.

requirements.summary: Produce trustworthy knowledge outcomes. Choose the investigation, editing and review method appropriate to the evidence; do not treat thinking steps as workflow gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Current facts and durable decisions are supported by supplied evidence and relevant implementation anchors, not by task intentions.
Affected Truth and ADR have clear ownership and consistent current-state claims; unchanged knowledge is a valid no-edit outcome.
Source materials and unrelated user edits are preserved; changed canonical content follows knowledge-format.md.
The result identifies changed paths, justified no-edit outcomes, and any unresolved conflict without claiming incomplete work succeeded.

tasks.title: Govern canonical Truth and ADR
tasks.detail: Interpret the supplied materials by their content. Use task status to scope results, not as proof of implementation. Locate the relevant existing owners, qualify current facts against current implementation where needed, and maintain Truth and durable ADR decisions as one coherent knowledge system. Choose and revisit your search, reading, editing and review order as useful. Do not manufacture facts or ADRs; retain useful historical evidence with clear scope. Preserve unrelated edits and repair only format issues relevant to the changed content or machine readability. A supported no-edit result is valid.

tasks.title: Verify knowledge consistency and report the outcome
tasks.detail: Check affected owners and their relevant references for contradictory current claims, lost decisions, unsafe scope changes and format problems. Select focused semantic or identifier searches according to the actual risk; do not repeatedly scan the entire corpus without a concrete reason. Correct conflicts within the current work, or report what remains unresolved. Return changed paths and evidence-backed no-edit or partial-result reasons. Canonical completion owns index-refresh scheduling; no manual refresh-preparation task is needed.

references.why: Preserves the full direct writer contract and detailed quality constraints.
Defines machine-stable state metadata and dated evolution units.

rules: Supplied materials are read-only. Preserve unrelated user edits and repository conventions.
Requirements, intentions, examples and history must not be silently promoted to implemented current behavior.
Maintain one current owner for each material fact or decision and keep Truth and ADR consistent.
Use knowledge-format.md for changed canonical content; retain useful dated evolution without rewriting untouched documents.
Recover known no-effect command errors within the current work. Do not replay accepted or outcome-unknown mutations; inspect canonical state and report unresolved dependencies honestly.
